message.reasoning:
The instruction: "compute total funds raised for all three tranches from Apr-25 to Jun-33." The "Total Fund Raised" section rows 28-31, columns O through DI. Target cells: O31:DI31? "total funds raised for all three tranches" — row 31 is "Third Tranche" but row 27 is "Total Fund Raised" label; there's no explicit total row... Actually rows 28-31 are Initial Investment, First, Second, Third tranche. "Total funds raised for all three tranches" — likely a total row. Hmm. Which cells does it ask to modify? Likely the row 31... no, that's Third Tranche. Maybe row 32 is cumulative fund size. The instruction says "compute total funds raised for all three tranches" — probably means the Total Fund Raised row for all three tranches — maybe rows 29-31 (First, Second, Third Tranche) plus initial investment? "all three tranches" = rows 29,30,31 across O:DI. The total would be row 31? No.

I think the target is the three tranche rows in the Total Fund Raised block: O29:DI31. Possibly including row 28 (Initial Investment). "total funds raised for all three tranches" — just the three tranches. So O29:DI31.
